digo: nyanya; mtamata (Pakia); traditional tomato mtindi / tindi
digo_source: Mgombato ('nyanya tomato'; 'mtindi traditional tomato plant'; 'tindi bush tomato'); Pakia ('Mtamata')

teaser.en: Long before the big market tomato, Digo gardens had their own small 'bush tomato', called *tindi*.
teaser.sw: Muda mrefu kabla ya nyanya kubwa za sokoni, bustani za Kidigo zilikuwa na 'nyanya ya porini' yao ndogo, iitwayo *tindi*.
teaser.dg: Kare sana, kabla ya nyanya kulu za sokoni, busitani za Adigo kala zina nyanya yao ndide ya chienyeji, inayoihwa *tindi*.

summary.en: *Nyanya* is the tomato, grown in gardens and used in kachumbari salad and stews. Digo also has its own words for a traditional, smaller tomato.
summary.sw: *Nyanya* ni nyanya, inayolimwa bustanini na kutumika katika kachumbari na michuzi. Kidigo pia kina maneno yake kwa nyanya ndogo ya jadi.
summary.dg: *Nyanya* (kpwa Chingereza *tomato*) nkurimwa busitani na nkuhumirwa kpwenye *kachumbari* na mtsuzi. Chidigo piya china manenoge kpwa nyanya ya chienyeji, iriyo ndide zaidi.

about.en: The tomato is a sprawling, hairy herb with strong-smelling, divided leaves and small yellow star-shaped flowers. The fruit is juicy and usually red when ripe. Traditional tomatoes are smaller than the large market kinds.
about.sw: Mnyanya ni mmea mdogo unaotanda na wenye vinyweleo, wenye majani yaliyogawanyika yenye harufu kali na maua madogo ya manjano yenye umbo la nyota. Tunda lina maji mengi na kwa kawaida huwa jekundu likiiva. Nyanya za jadi ni ndogo kuliko aina kubwa za sokoni.
about.dg: *Nyanya* ni mmea unaoenea photsi, wenye nyere, na makodza garigoganywa ganayolavya arufu kali, na maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano dza nyota. Nyanya ina madzi manji, na kpwa kawaida ni ya kundu ichiivwa. Nyanya za chienyeji ni ndide kuriko aina kulu za sokoni.

where.en: Tomatoes are grown in home gardens on the south coast.
where.sw: Nyanya hulimwa katika bustani za nyumbani katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Nyanya nkurimwa busitani za kaya pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: Tomatoes go into *kachumbari*, the fresh onion and tomato salad served with many coastal meals, and into stews.
uses.sw: Nyanya hutiwa katika *kachumbari*, saladi mbichi ya vitunguu na nyanya inayoliwa pamoja na milo mingi ya pwani, na katika michuzi.
uses.dg: Nyanya nkutiywa *kachumbari*, chakurya cha chitunguu na nyanya zisizojitwa chinachoriwa na vyakurya vinji vya pwani, na nkutiywa mtsuzi.

names.en: The Digo word is *nyanya*, the same as in Swahili, and Pakia records *mtamata*. The traditional tomato plant is *mtindi*, and its fruit, the bush tomato, is *tindi*. In English it is tomato.
names.sw: Neno la Kidigo ni *nyanya*, sawa na la Kiswahili, na Pakia anaandika *mtamata*. Mmea wa nyanya ya jadi ni *mtindi*, na tunda lake, nyanya ya porini, ni *tindi*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *tomato*.
names.dg: Neno ra Chidigo ni *nyanya*, sawa na Chiswahili, na Pakia anaandika *mtamata*. Mmea wa nyanya ya chienyeji ni *mtindi*, na tundare, nyanya ya chienyeji (*bush tomato*), ni *tindi*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *tomato*.

reason.dg: Chitunguu, chinachotiywa phamwenga na nyanya kpwenye *kachumbari*.

mgombato: mtindi2 (mi) traditional tomato plant; mnyanya wa kienyeji.
tindi (-) bush tomato; nyanya za kienyeji.
